units.text: INT. FAN - CONTINUOUS
Sitting .

Oh, men don’t matter. With women it is different. We’re good. Some of us are, at least. But we are positively getting elbowed into the corner. Our husbands would really forget our existence if we didn’t nag at them from time to time, just to remind them that we have a perfect legal right to do so.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: It’s a curious thing, Duchess, about the game of marriage—a game, by the way, that is going out of fashion—the wives hold all the honours, and invariably lose the odd trick.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: The odd trick? Is that the husband, Lord Darlington?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: It would be rather a good name for the modern husband.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Dear Lord Darlington, how thoroughly depraved you are!
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Lord Darlington is trivial.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Ah, don’t say that, Lady Windermere.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Why do you talk so trivially about life, then?
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Because I think that life is far too important a thing ever to talk seriously about it.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Moves up C.
What does he mean? Do, as a concession to my poor wits, Lord Darlington, just explain to me what you really mean.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Coming down back of table .
I think I had better not, Duchess. Nowadays to be intelligible is to be found out. Good-bye!
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Shakes hands with DUCHESS.
And now—
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: goes up stage.
Lady Windermere, good-bye. I may come to-night, mayn’t I? Do let me come.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Standing up stage with LORD DARLINGTON.
Yes, certainly. But you are not to say foolish, insincere things to people.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Smiling .
Ah! you are beginning to reform me. It is a dangerous thing to reform any one, Lady Windermere.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Bows , and exit C.
Who has risen , goes C.

What a charming, wicked creature! I like him so much. I’m quite delighted he’s gone! How sweet you’re looking! Where do you get your gowns? And now I must tell you how sorry I am for you, dear Margaret.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Crosses to sofa and sits with LADY WINDERMERE.
Agatha, darling!
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: Rises .
Will you go and look over the photograph album that I see there?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: Goes to table up L.
Dear girl! She is so fond of photographs of Switzerland. Such a pure taste, I think. But I really am so sorry for you, Margaret.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Smiling .
Why, Duchess?
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Oh, on account of that horrid woman. She dresses so well, too, which makes it much worse, sets such a dreadful example. Augustus—you know my disreputable brother—such a trial to us all—well, Augustus is completely infatuated about her. It is quite scandalous, for she is absolutely inadmissible into society. Many a woman has a past, but I am told that she has at least a dozen, and that they all fit.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Whom are you talking about, Duchess?
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: About Mrs. Erlynne.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Mrs. Erlynne? I never heard of her, Duchess. And what has she to do with me?
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: My poor child! Agatha, darling!
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: Will you go out on the terrace and look at the sunset?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Yes, mamma.
units.name: LADY AGATHA

units.text: Exit through window , L.
Sweet girl! So devoted to sunsets! Shows such refinement of feeling, does it not? After all, there is nothing like Nature, is there?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK
